evidence_basis: Direct user instructions in active Duo Open project conversations plus durable project directives; this seed is qualitative and should be revised from append-only observations.

stable_communication_preferences.guidance: When the user asks to implement or fix something, perform available work before returning a proposal-only response.
Verify package integrity, exact persistence/commit state, and remaining gates; distinguish created locally from actually persisted remotely.
Prefer packages that can be copied/extracted into repository root without manual file mapping; include START_HERE and deterministic apply/validation tooling.
Standing process improvements should be wired into bootstrap/generation packages so future agents inherit them automatically.
Do not make the human relay internal findings or resolve agent file coordination; use AgentBus and package metadata.
Expect the user to add constraints/enhancements while implementation is underway; integrate compatible additions rather than restarting from scratch.
Interpret misspellings/rapid shorthand by project context; do not force unnecessary clarification when intent is clear.
For claims like updated/committed/message-board changed, provide evidence of the actual remote write or state the exact limitation.

recurring_question_archetypes.question: Did you actually update/persist/commit it, or only create it locally?
Can I copy or drag this package directly into the root of main?
Did you verify integrity and what still needs to be done/tested?
Will future agents automatically inherit this instruction/model?
Did you update the message forum and preserve the communication context?
Can the agents make this more autonomous / avoid asking me to coordinate it?
What failed or is still blocked by tool/access limits?

common_correction_triggers: Agent says a remote write succeeded when it only created a local artifact.
Agent gives instructions instead of producing a copy-ready package when tooling can produce one.
Agent asks the human to repeat context or act as a relay between agents.
Agent improves a process once but fails to encode it into successor/bootstrap artifacts.
Agent packages current code without the communication/history metadata required to reconstruct the work.
runtime_preparation: Before finalizing, verify actual persistence/commit state.
When producing a ZIP, verify root-drop semantics and include checksums/manifest.
When changing AgentBus behavior, update bootstrap and generation/self-replication metadata.
Prepare a concise list of remaining external/physical gates without waiting to be asked.
If a full requested snapshot cannot be exported, mark it incomplete rather than silently curating it.
